scientific_integrity: The proof treats every symmetric stochastic chain on the specified graph, not merely orbit-symmetric candidates. The statement constructs a globally optimal chain but does not assert uniqueness of every edge weight or of unrestricted optimal chains. Published general SDP methods, the single-wheel theorem, the small K5-minus-edge example, and complete-multipartite spectral reductions are credited. Numerical tests are supporting diagnostics, not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Backbone H must be connected, simple, vertex-transitive and edge-transitive; the chain must be symmetric and allow holding. Earlier specialized coverage not located remains possible. The 2007-09-06 date denotes the verified arXiv v1 release of the focal paper; an April 2007 manuscript dateline and a possible May 2007 technical report do not establish an earlier exact public-release date.
title: A three-phase fastest-mixing law for double cones over transitive graphs
